feedback.Physical Object: Included — A bounded machine composed of rigid and moving parts.
feedback.Synthetic: Included — Fully engineered using manufactured materials.
feedback.Biological/Biomimetic: Excluded — No biological inspiration in core design.
feedback.Powered: Included — Requires electricity to operate motors and control boards.
feedback.Structural: Included — Has a defined spatial structure (frame, gantry, bed).
feedback.Observable: Included — Physically visible and often designed for user monitoring.
feedback.Physical Medium: Included — Composed of materials like aluminum, plastic, and electronics.
feedback.Active: Included — Performs complex mechanical actions during operation.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Included — Built specifically for additive manufacturing.
feedback.Outputs Effect: Included — Produces 3D objects as physical output.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Included — Interprets G-code and sensor feedback.
feedback.State-Transforming: Included — Melts, extrudes, and reshapes materials.
feedback.Human-Interactive: Included — Loaded, adjusted, and operated by people.
feedback.System-integrated: Included — May be part of lab, classroom, or industrial systems.
feedback.Functionally Autonomous: Included — Executes print cycles without further input once started.
feedback.System-Essential: Excluded — Usually replaceable or modular within a workflow.
feedback.Symbolic: Excluded — Not representational or symbolic in itself.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Uses displays, sounds, and lights to indicate status.
feedback.Compositional: Included — Composed of purposeful subsystems (e.g., extruder, frame, bed, firmware).
feedback.Normative: Excluded — Does not encode social rules or behaviors.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Print jobs and heating cycles unfold over time.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Included — Governed by digital files, software, and embedded firmware.
feedback.Social Construct: Excluded — Defined materially, not by consensus.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Excluded — Not categorized or mandated by institutional definitions.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Excluded — Not inherently tied to personal or cultural identity.
feedback.Regulated: Included — Subject to safety, emissions, and equipment standards.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Central to a growing industry in manufacturing, prototyping, and education.
feedback.Ritualised: Excluded — Not used in cultural or symbolic rituals.
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Raises concerns over sustainability, decentralized fabrication, and unregulated object creation.

encoding_notes: This encoding captures the 3D printer as a digitally controlled fabrication system with deep functional structure, rule-based operation, and ethical relevance. It spans all UHT layers with precision. Final UHT code: DFFE7319.
